defs.def: to make sth more modern by adding new parts, etc. 使现代化；更新

ex.s: has been updatedD. had been updated
It would help her update test﹣taking skills．
ex.t: A．这能帮助她更新应试技巧。

ex.s: To update consumers on new technology.
ex.t: 为了让消费者了解新技术。

ex.s: The baby was born and update texts were    47    quickly from the overjoyed grandmother, Teresa.
ex.t: 婴儿出生了，欣喜的祖母特蕾莎___47___迅速地发来了报喜短信。

ex.s: We would usually have posted pictures and updated our profiles.
ex.t: 我们通常会发布图片并更新我们的个人资料。

ex.s: You'll need to report back via weekly blogs, photo diaries and video updates.
ex.t: 你需要通过每周的博客、摄影日记和视频更新来汇报。

ex.s: On social media sites, people tend to post only positive updates that make them appear happy and friendly.
ex.t: 在社交媒体网站上，人们倾向于只发布让他们看起来快乐和友好的积极更新。

defs.def: to give sb the most recent information about sth; to add the most recent information to sth 向 … 提供最新信息；给 … 增加最新信息

ex.s: For the biggest stadiums in the world, we have used data supplied by the World Atlas list so far, which ranks them by their stated permanent capacity, as well as updated information from official stadium websites.
ex.t: 对于世界上最大的体育场，我们目前使用了世界地图册提供的数据，该数据按公布的固定容量对它们排名，并参考了官方体育场网站的更新信息。

ex.s: As well as looking after these incredible animals, I talk to visitors and post updates on social media.
ex.t: 除了照顾这些令人惊叹的动物外，我还与访客交谈并在社交媒体上发布最新动态。

ex.s: We have to be very sensitive and work closely with the doctors and nurses, who keep us updated on each patient.
ex.t: 我们必须非常敏感，并与医生和护士密切合作，他们随时向我们报告每个病人的最新情况。

defs.def: a report or broadcast that gives the most recent information about sth; a new version of sth containing the most recent information 最新报道；最新消息；最新进展
the most recent improvements to a computer program that are sent to users of the program （计算机程序的）更新，最新校正数据

ex.s: Your application will be accessed by UNESCO managers and will stay in our database for six months．We do not respond to every candidate．If selected，you will be contacted by a manager．If you do not receive any update within six months，it means that your application has not been successful．
ex.t: 你的申请将由联合国教科文组织的经理审阅，并在我们的数据库中保留六个月。我们不会回复每一位候选人。如果被选中，会有经理与你联系。如果六个月内未收到任何更新，则意味着你的申请未获成功。
